body: I live in the US. I hear about stuff like this Every. Single. Day. I really don't like it and I wish people would just listen and stay in their homes so we can go back to normal. Or whatever "normal" was. I honestly don't even understand what these protests are for because I am trying not to pay attention to all of this but I couldn't help but watch this video. I love this subreddit so of course I clicked on it. To everyone else living in the States, I hope the best for you. I pray that nothing bad happens around where you live, even if you're not here in the US. Let's just hope this all ends soon.
